description: Syntax highlighting, compile errors and completion for .sal — triggers, events, fibers.
config.server.path: Full path to DslLsp.dll (the LSP server). Empty — search the workspace (Tools/DslLsp/publish, then bin/...). Absolute or relative to the workspace root; ${workspaceFolder} is supported. It must be the .dll, not the .exe: the server is started as «dotnet <path>». Reload the window after changing it.
config.apiManifest: Path to salamander-api.json. Empty — search the workspace root, then the nearest one in subfolders. Absolute or relative to the root; ${workspaceFolder} is supported.
config.modulesRoot: Folder under which to look for modules (module.json) and .sal files. Empty — the workspace root. In a Unity project set it to, for example, Assets/StreamingAssets/Core.
config.referencePaths: Folders with reference modules — those the game sees but the workspace does not contain (the game's base scripts, mod dependencies). They are compiled together with the workspace only for references and hints: classes, fields, methods with signatures and «///» descriptions, go to definition. Their errors are not shown. Only modules the workspace depends on are taken. Absolute paths or relative to the root; ${workspaceFolder} is supported.
config.buildFile: Path to salamander-build.json (an ordered list of module folders). Empty — search the modules root. If the file exists, EXACTLY the modules listed in it are taken.
config.language: Language of compiler errors, hints and documentation (including the game's documentation when it is given in two languages). Empty — from salamander-build.json, otherwise Russian.
